workshoptitle: Real-Time AI Fraud Monitoring with OCI GoldenGate and Oracle AI Database Private Agent Factory

tutorials.title: Get Started
tutorials.description: Sign in to your LiveLabs Sandbox and locate the reservation details.

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Review the fraud monitoring scenario, objectives, and prerequisites.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Review and access the environment resources
tutorials.description: Review the provisioned GoldenGate deployment, connection, and fraud monitoring console.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Create and start the GoldenGate Extract process
tutorials.description: Use GoldenGate MCP through PAF to create and start the payment transaction Extract.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Create the GoldenGate Data Stream process
tutorials.description: Create and inspect a Data Stream that distributes captured payment changes.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Generate source payment transactions
tutorials.description: Insert sample payment transactions and verify them in the source database.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Verify the complete fraud monitoring pipeline
tutorials.description: Trace a transaction through capture, streaming, risk scoring, and PAF analysis.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Monitor GoldenGate and query operational evidence
tutorials.description: Review GoldenGate performance and query live process evidence through MCP.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Review the AI Agents configuration in Private Agent Factory
tutorials.description: Inspect the published GoldenGate and fraud analyst agent flows and their MCP configuration.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving LiveLabs support.
